rationale: Forge's imported shader-capable controls need time-driven shaders and built-in widget animations to keep the editor frame loop live without paying for repeated RTTI searches across the entire view tree. The retained continuous-frame traversal now uses each built-in widget's runtime kind for its allocation-free hot path while preserving CustomShaderHost as the fail-closed extension point for untagged views and shader hosts that inherit an existing non-shader kind. The behavior remains Pulp-specific plugin-UI integration: static trees still idle, time uniforms and active widget transitions keep repainting, and future mixed-in shader hosts remain discoverable without transferring source authority or backporting a named Vellum change.
